## Decision

### Continue

Use when repeated, expensive, Nitely-addressable failures appear in at least 3
attempts.

### Narrow

Use when the pain exists but only for a specific segment or task family.

### Pause

Use when the pain is weak, non-repeated, not production-oriented, or outside
Nitely's local spec-to-PR workflow.
